purpose: Compare the fitted Magnicon+c2 readout transfer shapes directly across 2024-12-05 and 2024-12-06, without allowing detector nuisance or white-floor refits to absorb readout-shape differences.
guardrail: This diagnostic compares the fitted effective readout transfer coordinates directly. Passing would support transfer-shape repeatability; failing does not identify the source of drift because the fitted c2/cutoff remain phenomenological and may compensate detector-model deficiencies. The current Connector Box LPF is observed ON, but the 2024-12-05/06 measurement-time state is not independently logged.
